research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: official occupations, first speech, contemporaneous ABC biographies, public professional-profile index and tribunal employment chronology inspected. Frozen roster preserved.

First speech reports 15 years in employment services and periods of unemployment. This does not reconcile directly with the two dated adviser entries; locate all providers, jobs and breaks before measuring any duration. No unemployment dates manufactured.

All ordinary-work employer identities, ownership/control at the time, substantive full-time status and leave remain unproved. Titles, total years in an industry and broad overlapping dates do not establish full-time paid intervals. Headline values remain null, not zero.

Targeted searches for corporate-services/community-development employer, job agencies including National Joblink/CVGT/WISE, early farm/petrol work and 2018–20 adviser role did not identify a defensible employer chronology. National Joblink qualification, Asuria visit and namesake real-estate/Canadian employment results are not employment evidence.

Follow up historical public CV versions, legitimate employer annual reports once employers identified, precise 2017 separation/later reappointment, 2018–20 overlap, hours/leave and earlier seasonal/factory jobs. The 1990–95 secondary farm dates remain a lead; official 1998–2005 dates are preserved.

Source gaps: personal website returned Internal Error and beta website returned (400) Timeout fetching; official Federal Court judgment URL was inaccessible through search tool. Tribunal judgment mirror supplied narrow employment-date evidence. An ABC re-open returned Internal Error after earlier retrieval/index access. These source failures did not terminate the run.

Follow-up2026-10-02(non-material): recovered full ABC23May2022page and rechecked public tribunal text paragraph25 and first speech. They corroborate existing facts without new employers, hours or dates. ABC references LinkedIn without exposing an original historical profile link; current profile index remains incomplete.

Searches for corporate/community-development employer,2005council work, employment providers,2018–20adviser position and full-time status returned current Senate activities and advertisements recruiting her staff, not her employment terms. Canadian Inuvialuit2019employment-officer namesake excluded; no identity match. CVGT donor-list co-occurrence and visits to providers do not establish employment.

No substantive new fact or completion in this pass. Prior gaps persist; next follow-up needs a historical professional CV or employer-specific documentary lead before repeating broad job-title searches. Retain15-year employment-services account and unresolved overlap rather than manufacture a continuous interval.

Follow-up2026-10-04: current first-party Labor biography newly confirms factory work in addition to paddock and office work. Added a completeness spell without assigning employer, dates, control, hours or a second duration over the broad labouring interval. Targeted title and National Joblink searches otherwise repeated the official chronology and did not identify any employment-services provider; training-provider attendance and later visits were not treated as employment.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Extended employer-specific searches to MAX and Workskills alongside corporate-services titles and historical CV terms. Results paired current political posts with provider accounts or unrelated staff; no attributable employment at either provider was found. Public senator-profile index remains incomplete. Full-time advertisements concern staff hired by Tyrrell, not her own earlier terms, and were excluded. A Cadbury factory speech describes the company workforce without claiming her employment there; no factory employer inferred. Existing fifteen-year employment-services account, unknown providers and2018–2020overlap remain unresolved. Further repeated broad searches deferred pending historical CV or named-employer lead.
